global.notes: Engine uses wgpu with Y-up coordinate system (standard GL conventions)

vertex_attributes.notes: Engine does NOT read vertex colors. Wind animation uses local Y position.

wind_animation.description: Wind intensity is derived from vertex Y position in local/model space
guidance: Tips/leaves at higher Y values sway more
For fern: frond tips should be at Y > 0.3m for visible sway

albedo.notes: RGBA - alpha channel used for leaf cutout

normal.notes: Not currently sampled by foliage shader

textures.compression_notes: PNG-8 for simple alpha, PNG-24+alpha for foliage. GLB embeds textures automatically.

materials.notes: Engine reads alpha_mode, alpha_cutoff, double_sided from GLTF material

limits.notes: From gltf_loader.rs - generous limits, but keep foliage lightweight for instancing

fern.lod_notes: LOD not implemented yet - export single mesh

placement.notes: Matches vegetation.rs height_to_biome() - DeciduousForest is 8-40m terrain height

wind_guidance.sway_expectation: Tips will sway gently, base stays grounded

grass.notes: Grass is procedurally generated, not model-based

wind_guidance.uv_convention: trunk uv.y <= 1.0, canopy uv.y > 1.0 for procedural coloring fallback

export_checklist: Set origin to base center (median point at ground level)
Verify scale in meters (1 Blender unit = 1 meter)
Check UV mapping - single UV channel, no overlapping for alpha
Embed textures in GLB (or place alongside for GLTF)
Set material alpha_mode to MASK, alpha_cutoff to 0.5
Test alpha cutoff visually in Blender

naming_convention.notes: Ferns use 1-indexed 2-digit numbers (fern_01, fern_02). Other foliage uses 0-indexed single digit.
